{{Top|leg}}
'''Galactic Syndicated''' was a ghost corporation in [[45 ABY]], that was owned and operated as a front for two [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, the criminals [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]]. It was used as a means to funnel their many different corporate assets into a singular corporation as they attempted a hostile takeover of the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] economy.
